prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE NEW treasure chest sprite for an EVIL DUNGEON, matching these two references.
REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is an approved sinister idol, authoritative for chunky painted craftsmanship, broad slate/charcoal forms, angular softened bevels and restrained violet accents. Image 2 is the actual game, authoritative for the orthographic 2:1 ground camera and visual style. Do not reproduce the idol or scene.
DESIGN: a squat, menacing ritual strongbox belonging to the dungeon's keeper. Obviously a CLOSED hinged storage chest, but built like a little sealed prison for treasure. Broad low faceted lid (three planes, NOT a cheerful round pirate barrel), subtly tapered chunky body, thick blackened iron ribs clasping around it like claws. Two short swept-back thorn-shaped ends on the upper side fittings give a distinctive sinister silhouette, small and structural, not oversized horns. Muted almost-black plum wood visible in THREE large recessed panels. One large recessed angular VIOLET ARCANE SEAL in the front clasp, simple enough to read at 96 pixels wide; a dark central slot preserves the visual idea of a lock. One tiny restrained violet line in the lid seam, contained inside the object. No gold or brass anywhere, no shiny treasure-shop styling, no red leather, no adventurer ornament.
ART: dark fantasy cartoon hand-painted sprite, thick dark navy contour, quiet broad two/three-tone shading, cool slate edge facets to keep black iron readable on blue dungeon paving. More like the approved idol's heavy sculpted planes than a realistic metal product. Large uncluttered shapes. Evil through silhouette and heavy restraints, NOT a face or mimic creature: no eyes, mouth, teeth or skull. No chains, microscopic rivets, dense runes, photorealistic grain, glossy reflections, orange wood, pedestal or ground patch.
CAMERA: true game 2:1 orthographic/dimetric view, same as current dungeon. See top, broad front and short right side. Vertical edges upright; ground-aligned base edges run at slopes +0.5 and -0.5, no perspective convergence. Footprint rectangular about 1.4 to 1; overall low body, flat grounded bottom with short corner feet. Frame the ENTIRE object with clear margins.
OUTPUT: one isolated complete solid opaque sprite on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Crisp cutout with native alpha. No external glow, mist, shadow, vignette, ground illumination, surrounding blue haze or background pixels. Violet is painted only INSIDE the clasp and seam. Everything outside the thin contour must be empty transparent space. No text, UI, border or checkerboard.
